title: Breathing with the Seasons
subtitle: Mediterranean Annual Temperature Cycle
description: Listen to Earth's orbital rhythm — the same harmonic rise and fall repeating year after year as the planet tilts toward and away from the sun.

title: A Decadal Drift
subtitle: 24-Year Urban Warming in Tokyo Basin
description: Hear 24 years of data as a continuous upward pitch drift. Each decade's baseline climbs a little higher — this is long-term climate change rendered as sound.

title: Heat Dome: Pacific Northwest
subtitle: 2021 Catastrophic Heat Anomaly
description: A calm spring baseline is shattered in late June 2021. When temperature crosses 38°C (100°F) a layered alarm fires. The highest note represents 39.3°C — the hottest ever recorded in this region.

title: Amazon Rainfall Pulse
subtitle: 9-Year Precipitation Seasonality
description: Experience the heartbeat of the world's largest rainforest. The wet season roars with deep, saturated tones; the dry season quiets to a subtle hum.

title: Black Summer Bushfires
subtitle: 2019–20 Australian Catastrophe
description: Australia's most devastating fire season in recorded history. Temperature builds through winter into catastrophic spring/summer heat. The alert fires repeatedly above 40°C as heatwave after heatwave strikes New South Wales.
